reason: I buy bread and labneh at the dekkene almost every day, and the owner is my neighbour and lets me pay at the end of the month. I am not going to plan a list before 2 and walk to a pickup point at 6 to save a little on a few items.
objection: A $2 fee on a small daily bag eats whatever I would save, and I lose the tab and the fresh bread I pick up when I need it. I also don't know who these people are or who is holding my money and my list.
would_change_my_mind: If they accepted payment at the end of the month like the dekkene, the fee was well under a dollar, and the pickup point was on my street.
